profile.headline: React Native & Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My name is Deida (day-da), and I’m a Full Stack and React Native engineer with 5+ years building consumer mobile apps across iOS and Android 📱

I am a big fan of team work and collaboration between product, design, and engineering, especially when problems are still ambiguous, and helping shape solid, scalable solutions. I own features end-to-end, from technical scoping through deployment and iteration, and I thrive in teams that value thoughtful tradeoffs, communication, and continuous improvement. 

I adapt quickly, love learning and documentation, and appreciate feedback because it enables us to grow 🌱

Outside of work: I am a Techqueria OC Chapter chair (organizing events for local Latinos in Tech to network), antique hunter, and like to experiment with plant-based recipes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer developing apps at Hearth, a centralized Smart Display empowering families with organizational and AI tools such as shared calendars, chore charts, routines, and meal planning

• Supported 0-1 development of Companion Mobile app → Shipped full-stack from feature discovery through production, driving 250% usage growth and doubling Display touchpoints within 6 months of launch
• Owned mobile frontend calendar system →  Built multiple calendar views, multi-user management, and multi-source event search
• Co-developed the Rewards and Points system → Frontend ownership from reward creation and reward approval, through points assignments (tasks/routines), driving 35% growth in weekly active users
• Refactored Routines system for scale → Identified loading bottleneck, partnered with backend to split endpoints, delivered optimized frontend consuming lazy-loaded details on demand resulting in an 86% API performance improvement and Apdex scores increasing from 0.79 to 0.94-0.97
• Delivered device security features → Built Lock Screen with passcode authentication and display settings, giving families control over device access across the kiosk fleet
• Extended AI-powered content classification and generation (Hearth Helper) → used prompt engineering and delivered frontend integration enabling users to add tasks and to-do lists via text or photo inputs
• Managed production releases across App Store, Google Play, display deployments and backend → Feature flags, staged rollouts, post-release monitoring on recurring on-call rotation
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Expo · Python (Programming Language) · Release Management · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Debugging · Cross-team Collaboration · Sentry · Optimizing Performance · Communication · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Engineer II on the Care/of: Build Healthy Habits mobile app (React Native, JavaScript), helping users build and maintain daily routines through personalized vitamin plans, reminders, and a point-based rewards system.

• Shipped one-time purchase flow → Built in-app cart, checkout, and product selection experiences enabling a new purchasing model in collaboration with backend for new existing and new users
• Built companion Sleep tracking app onboarding → Login and signup flows, sleep goal setup, notification configuration, and preference persistence
• Iterated on core features via A/B testing → Rewards screen, onboarding simplifications, navigation updates
• Managed release cycles → Deployed with Bitrise and monitored app health using Sentry, Segment, and Firebase Crashlytics
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Code Review · JavaScript · Release Management · Stripe (Software) · Cross-team Collaboration · Communication · Debugging · Troubleshooting · Mobile Applications · GitHub · GraphQL · Time Management · Sentry

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer, West Tenth - Marketplace mobile app

• Built review system end-to-end → Request reviews from buyers post-purchase, review submissions, and display on storefront profiles and admin panel for CS to manage flagged reviews (React Native frontend, Node.js/GraphQL backend with PostgresQL, and React admin panel)
• Integrated messaging with Tilio → In-app messaging between buyers and sellers with admin panel for conversations and support
• Implemented search with Algolia → Storefront search across product names, descriptions, locations, and seller profiles
• Shipped seller onboarding improvements → Photo requirements, seller profile setup, buyer/seller view toggle with state persistence and global context updates
• Built notifications hub and admin panel → User notifications across app flows, admin tooling for CS to send cohort-based or individual notifications
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Node.js · Apollo GraphQL · React Native · Express.js · React.js · Git · Unit Testing · Stripe (Software) · Code Review · Communication · Debugging · Troubleshooting · TypeScript · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · PostgreSQL · Codepush · Mobile Applications · Next.js · GitHub · Release Management · GraphQL · Time Management · Postman · Cross-team Collaboration

projects.title: Bountiful (nutrition tracker)
projects.description:
Bountifull is a health-positive nutrition tracker built for mobile.

Worked with a team of three other developers to build this app from the ground up, including deployment. Contributed on the backend with server development, and database planning, and the frontend, including building this mobile app and features like implementing data visualization for the user's inputs, calendar with color coding to improve user experience, and image uploading features using AWS S3.

Tech stack: React Native, Axios, Redux, Expo, Node, Express, MongoDB, USDA API, Heroku, AWS S3

Collaborators: May Woolcott, Chris Gomez, Chase Klaus

projects.title: LocalTradeApp
projects.description:
Full stack development of a location-based, community trading app where users are encouraged to trade local produce, with the goal of cultivating local communities, and fighting the food insecurity and the food waste problems.

Tech stack: React Native, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL. JWT for user authentication.
Wireframing with Figma
